name: smwgraphics-redrawn-styled-burner
title: Redrawn Styled Burner
description:
Redrawn-style graphics for Super Mario Bros. 3's Burner custom sprite recreation from KobaBeach and an anonymous coder from VIP and Wall and Alaska Mix 5, meant to resemble the enemy's modern design.

A brief explanation is included on how to change the sprite's palette, due to being hardcoded in the sprite itself rather than in its respective .json files.

Credit's not necessary but appreciated regardless.
